tooltip.svo_core.alamite: Its distinctive fluorescence makes it a favorite among rock collectors.
tooltip.svo_core.baryte: The best specimens resemble a desert rose.
tooltip.svo_core.bixite: A dark metallic Mineral sought after for its cubic structure.
tooltip.svo_core.calcite: This yellow crystal is speckled with shimmering nodules.
tooltip.svo_core.dolomite: It can occur in coral reefs, often near an underwater volcano.
tooltip.svo_core.earth_crystal: A resinous substance found near the surface.
tooltip.svo_core.emerald: A precious stone with a brilliant green color.
tooltip.svo_core.esperite: The crystals glow bright green when stimulated.
tooltip.svo_core.fire_opal: A rare variety of opal, named for its red spots.
tooltip.svo_core.fire_quartz: A glowing red crystal commonly found near hot lava.
tooltip.svo_core.fluorapatite: Small amounts are found in human teeth.
tooltip.svo_core.frozen_tear: A crystal fabled to be the frozen tears of a yeti.
tooltip.svo_core.helvite: It grows in a triangular column.
tooltip.svo_core.jagoite: A high volume of tiny crystals makes it very glittery.
tooltip.svo_core.jamborite: The crystals are so tightly packed it almost looks fuzzy.
tooltip.svo_core.kyanite: The geometric faces are as smooth as glass.
tooltip.svo_core.lemon_stone: Some claim the powdered crystal is a dwarvish delicacy.
tooltip.svo_core.lunarite: The cratered white orbs form a tight cluster.
tooltip.svo_core.malachite: A popular ornamental stone, used in sculpture and to make green paint.
tooltip.svo_core.nekoite: The delicate shards form a tiny pink meadow.
tooltip.svo_core.neptunite: A jet-black crystal that is unusually reflective.
tooltip.svo_core.opal: Its internal structure causes it to reflect a rainbow of light.
tooltip.svo_core.prismatic_shard: A very rare and powerful substance with unknown origins.
tooltip.svo_core.quartz: A clear crystal commonly found in caves and mines.
tooltip.svo_core.ruby: A precious stone that is sought after for its rich color and beautiful luster.
tooltip.svo_core.tigerseye: A stripe of shimmering gold gives this gem a warm luster.
tooltip.svo_core.topaz: Fairly common but still prized for its beauty.
